profile.headline: Software Engineer, Quality @ Shield AI
profile.summary: My name is Miko Brown and I’m a UC San Diego graduate with a degree in Mathematics and Computer Science, where I balanced rigorous academics with being a Division 1 student-athlete. I’m currently a full-time Engineer II at Shield AI focusing on software quality, where I’m applying my passion for problem-solving and innovation to build the world's best AI pilot.

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Quality
positions.description:
Working on Hivemind, the world’s best AI pilot
- Owned product quality for customer software releases 
- Architected automated E2E/UI testing in ADO and Gitlab pipelines 
- Executed hardware and software in the loop (SIL/HIL) testing on aircraft in air-gapped Linux environments 
- Developed documentation to clarify and speed up software release process 
- Led bug triage, requiring great attention to detail and product knowledge

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing and installing flight critical software on the Modernized Gray Eagle UAV with maximum gross takeoff weight of over 4,000lbs and flight endurance of over 40 hours
- Engineering C, C++, and Python code, configuring Makefiles
- Containerizing software with Podman/Docker
- Configuring Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) operating systems
- Building testing frameworks for code coverage
- Creating data visualizations of software architecture
- Maintaining a DOD security clearance
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · C (Programming Language) · Linux · Makefile · Unit Testing · C++ · Containerization · Gitlab

positions.title: Mathematics & Computer Science | Division 1 Student-Athlete | Rowing
Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Containerized software and developed networking script
- Built containers for software tools using Podman/Docker
- Updated Python networking script to check connection between aircraft and the ground
- Managed version control with Subversion (SVN) and GitLab

positions.title: Rapid Prototype Development Intern
positions.description:
- Developing Web Applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Node.js
- Querying SQL databases through a REST API and performing data wrangling using Python scripts
- Developing interactive 2D/3D data visualizations with D3.js and Three.js
- Managing project collaboration version control using Subversion

positions.title: Retail Cashier
positions.description: Oversaw front of the store, offering excellent customer service

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description: Tutored students to understand and gain confidence in math

positions.title: Research Project Lead
positions.description:
- Led a university-level research project investigating non-visible electromagnetic waves
- Created a pinhole camera using antennas, a function generator, and a spectrum analyzer
- I worked largely individually with assistance from my mentor Dr. Salem and another high school student
- This project culminated in a presentation at a research symposium where I shared my findings with other research students.

volunteerExperiences.description: Coached middle school students in rowing, introducing them to the sport and helping them become interested in athletics and staying healthy.
I strongly believe in service to others. I packed and delivered weekly food boxes for my local homeless shelter on Saturday mornings to families in need.
